trivial.description: Cheapest/fastest model, fully autonomous. Typos, lint fixes, single-file mechanical changes.

easy.description: Small, well-specified bugfixes or features. Fully autonomous.

standard.description: Default tier for most issue work. Edits apply automatically; shell commands still pause for approval, so this tier needs --mode interactive (or an explicit --agent-flags bypassPermissions) — an autonomous spawn with it is refused.

hard.description: Tricky refactors, ambiguous specs, anything touching shared/critical code. Shell commands pause for approval, so this tier needs --mode interactive (or an explicit --agent-flags bypassPermissions) — an autonomous spawn with it is refused.

extreme.description: Hardest problems, strongest available model. Shell commands pause for approval, so this tier needs --mode interactive (or an explicit --agent-flags bypassPermissions) — an autonomous spawn with it is refused. For a second harness's judgment alongside claude, override with e.g. --agent codex or --agent pi — verify their exact model ids yourself, this repo doesn't validate them.
